text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We attend a meet and greet for fans and
their
families.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Okaaay! It's time for lunch, everyone! ♪

text_block_list.name: Timid Girl
text_block_list.text: C-Curren! Um... This is my omelet...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Wow! It looks delicious! It's so fluffy and
shiny!

text_block_list.name: Timid Girl
text_block_list.text:
Y-yeah! My mom's omelets are the best!
You can
try some too!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Really?! Thank you! Okay, Mom, I'll have
just one
bite!

text_block_list.name: Timid Girl's Mother
text_block_list.text:
So cute! B-by all means, have as much as
you
want!

text_block_list.name: Energetic Boy
text_block_list.text:
C-Curren! You can have some of my
lunch too!

text_block_list.name: Precocious Girl
text_block_list.text:
Hey, no fair! I wanna give Curren my
whole lunch!
My dad's rice balls are
top-class!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Everything?! You're all so sweet. I
dunno if I
can eat all this!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
But hey, umm... aren't these your
favorite foods?
I'd feel bad if I ate them
all myself...

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: IT'S FINE!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...W-wow! Really? Maybe we should ask
your
parents first...

text_block_list.name: Parents
text_block_list.text: WE'D BE HONORED!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hm... Are you suuuure?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hm... Are you suuuure?

text_block_list.text:
Hey, everyone. I think my trainer's
hungry too. Do
you mind if I share?

hungry too. Do
you mind if I share?

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: SURE!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Wow! Thanks!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: And thank you too, Big Bro. ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: And thank you too, Big Sis. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, we enjoy the rest of the meet
and greet
lunch party.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Okay! ☆ I'm super full. Thank you so
much,
everyone! ♪

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Take this too!
And this! And this!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Awww, thanks. ♪ Your love makes me so
happy!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I know! How about you try feeding me
some of
your lunches? ♪ Your moms and
dads can take
pictures. ☆

text_block_list.name: Parents
text_block_list.text:
Oh. My. GOSH! Curren Chan, you're so
cute!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Everyone uploads their pictures to social
media
after that, and before long,

#CurrenChanMeetandGreet is trending
at number
one!
